title: Implementar mecanicas 01 (Asignacion de entrega) + 02 (Temporizador 60s)
request: Implementar las mecanicas 01 y 02 de Delivery: 60 Seconds en el place: scripts servidor/cliente, destinos y estacion de recogida con ProximityPrompt.

operations.source:
--!strict
--============================================================
-- GameConfig (ModuleScript) — v2
-- Ubicación: ServerScriptService
-- Fuente única de verdad de TODOS los valores del juego.
--
-- Cambios v2 (Mecánica 02 - Temporizador):
--  * Nueva sección Timer: duración INVARIANTE de 60 segundos.
--  * Los modificadores ya NO alteran el tiempo (se eliminó
--    TimeMultiplier); ahora declaran DifficultyTag como hook
--    de dificultad para futuros eventos.
--============================================================

export type DeliveryModifier = {
	Id: string,
	DisplayName: string,
	RewardMultiplier: number,
	DifficultyTag: string, -- hook de dificultad para eventos; NUNCA altera el tiempo
	Weight: number,        -- peso de probabilidad relativa
}

export type DeliveryConfig = {
	BaseReward: number,    -- moneda base por entrega
	RewardPerStud: number, -- moneda extra por stud de distancia
	MinDistance: number,   -- distancia mínima válida al destino (studs)
	MaxDistance: number,   -- distancia máxima válida al destino (studs)
	ArrivalRadius: number, -- radio de llegada al destino (studs)
	Modifiers: { DeliveryModifier },
}

export type TimerConfig = {
	Duration: number,         -- INVARIANTE: exactamente 60 segundos
	WarningThreshold: number, -- segundos restantes para entrar en Warning
	TickRate: number,         -- frecuencia del bucle del servidor
	SyncRate: number,         -- re-sincronización periódica del HUD
}

local Config = {
	Delivery = {
		BaseReward = 50,
		RewardPerStud = 0.25,
		MinDistance = 50,
		MaxDistance = 800,
		ArrivalRadius = 8,
		Modifiers = {
			{ Id = "Normal",  DisplayName = "Normal",  RewardMultiplier = 1.00, DifficultyTag = "None",    Weight = 50 },
			{ Id = "Express", DisplayName = "Exprés",  RewardMultiplier = 1.50, DifficultyTag = "FarOnly", Weight = 25 },
			{ Id = "Fragil",  DisplayName = "Frágil",  RewardMultiplier = 1.75, DifficultyTag = "NoFalls", Weight = 15 },
			{ Id = "Pesado",  DisplayName = "Pesado",  RewardMultiplier = 2.00, DifficultyTag = "Slow",    Weight = 10 },
		},
	} :: DeliveryConfig,

	Timer = {
		Duration = 60,
		WarningThreshold = 10,
		TickRate = 0.1,
		SyncRate = 5,
	} :: TimerConfig,
}

return Config

--!strict
--============================================================
-- DeliveryStateMachine (ModuleScript)
-- Ubicación: ServerScriptService
-- FSM de la mecánica de entrega. Rechaza transiciones ilegales.
--============================================================

export type DeliveryState = "Idle" | "Delivering" | "Completed" | "Failed"

type Internal = {
	CurrentState: DeliveryState,
}

-- Transiciones permitidas: los estados ilegales son imposibles por diseño
local VALID_TRANSITIONS: { [DeliveryState]: { DeliveryState } } = {
	Idle = { "Delivering" },
	Delivering = { "Completed", "Failed" },
	Completed = { "Idle" },
	Failed = { "Idle" },
}

local DeliveryStateMachine = {}
DeliveryStateMachine.__index = DeliveryStateMachine

export type DeliveryStateMachine = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Internal, DeliveryStateMachine))

function DeliveryStateMachine.new(): DeliveryStateMachine
	local self = setmetatable({} :: Internal, DeliveryStateMachine)
	self.CurrentState = "Idle"
	return self
end

function DeliveryStateMachine:CanTransitionTo(newState: DeliveryState): boolean
	local allowed = VALID_TRANSITIONS[self.CurrentState]
	return table.find(allowed, newState) ~= nil
end

function DeliveryStateMachine:SetState(newState: DeliveryState): boolean
	if self.CurrentState == newState then
		return false
	end
	if not self:CanTransitionTo(newState) then
		warn(("[DeliveryFSM] Transición ilegal: %s -> %s"):format(self.CurrentState, newState))
		return false
	end
	self:OnExitState(self.CurrentState)
	self.CurrentState = newState
	self:OnEnterState(newState)
	return true
end

function DeliveryStateMachine:OnEnterState(_state: DeliveryState)
	-- Hooks de entrada (extender aquí si se necesita)
end

function DeliveryStateMachine:OnExitState(_state: DeliveryState)
	-- Hooks de salida (extender aquí si se necesita)
end

return DeliveryStateMachine

--!strict
--============================================================
-- TimerStateMachine (ModuleScript)
-- Ubicación: ServerScriptService
-- FSM del temporizador. Rechaza transiciones ilegales.
--
-- Flujo: Idle -> Running -> Warning -> Expired/Stopped -> Idle
--============================================================

export type TimerState = "Idle" | "Running" | "Warning" | "Expired" | "Stopped"

type Internal = {
	CurrentState: TimerState,
}

-- Transiciones permitidas: los estados ilegales son imposibles por diseño
local VALID_TRANSITIONS: { [TimerState]: { TimerState } } = {
	Idle = { "Running" },
	Running = { "Warning", "Expired", "Stopped" },
	Warning = { "Expired", "Stopped" },
	Expired = { "Idle" },
	Stopped = { "Idle" },
}

local TimerStateMachine = {}
TimerStateMachine.__index = TimerStateMachine

function TimerStateMachine.new(): TimerStateMachine
	local self = setmetatable({} :: Internal, TimerStateMachine)
	self.CurrentState = "Idle"
	return self
end

function TimerStateMachine:CanTransitionTo(newState: TimerState): boolean
	local allowed = VALID_TRANSITIONS[self.CurrentState]
	return table.find(allowed, newState) ~= nil
end

function TimerStateMachine:SetState(newState: TimerState): boolean
	if self.CurrentState == newState then
		return false
	end
	if not self:CanTransitionTo(newState) then
		warn(("[TimerFSM] Transición ilegal: %s -> %s"):format(self.CurrentState, newState))
		return false
	end
	self:OnExitState(self.CurrentState)
	self.CurrentState = newState
	self:OnEnterState(newState)
	return true
end

function TimerStateMachine:OnEnterState(_state: TimerState)
	-- Hooks de entrada (extender aquí si se necesita)
end

function TimerStateMachine:OnExitState(_state: TimerState)
	-- Hooks de salida (extender aquí si se necesita)
end

export type TimerStateMachine = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Internal, TimerStateMachine))

return TimerStateMachine

--!strict
--============================================================
-- TimerService (ModuleScript)
-- Ubicación: ServerScriptService
-- Motor de cuenta regresiva reutilizable, autoritativo en servidor.
-- Usa workspace:GetServerTimeNow() para que el HUD del cliente
-- se sincronice sin deriva.
--
-- INVARIANTE: la duración SIEMPRE es Config.Timer.Duration (60s).
-- Los eventos de dificultad NUNCA alteran el tiempo.
--============================================================

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)
local TimerStateMachine = require(script.Parent.TimerStateMachine)

-- Remotos del HUD (autónomos: se crean si no existen)
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TimerRemotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotesFolder.Name = "TimerRemotes"
	remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getOrCreateRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local remote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return remote
	end
	local newRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	newRemote.Name = name
	newRemote.Parent = remotesFolder
	return newRemote
end

local TimerStartRemote = getOrCreateRemote("TimerStart") -- Servidor -> Cliente: inicia el reloj
local TimerSyncRemote = getOrCreateRemote("TimerSync")   -- Servidor -> Cliente: corrección de deriva
local TimerEndRemote = getOrCreateRemote("TimerEnd")     -- Servidor -> Cliente: fin (Expired/Stopped)

type Internal = {
	player: Player,
	machine: TimerStateMachine.TimerStateMachine,
	duration: number,
	warningThreshold: number,
	endsAt: number,
	running: boolean,
	generation: number,
	OnTick: ((remaining: number) -> ())?,
	OnWarning: (() -> ())?,
	OnExpired: (() -> ())?,
	OnStopped: ((reason: string) -> ())?,
}

local TimerService = {}
TimerService.__index = TimerService

function TimerService.new(player: Player): Timer
	local self = setmetatable({} :: Internal, TimerService)
	self.player = player
	self.machine = TimerStateMachine.new()
	self.duration = Config.Timer.Duration
	self.warningThreshold = Config.Timer.WarningThreshold
	self.endsAt = 0
	self.running = false
	self.generation = 0
	return self
end

function TimerService:IsRunning(): boolean
	return self.running
end

function TimerService:TimeLeft(): number
	if not self.running then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, self.endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function TimerService:CurrentState(): TimerStateMachine.TimerState
	return self.machine.CurrentState
end

function TimerService:Start(duration: number?)
	if self.running then
		return -- no se puede reiniciar un reloj en curso (FSM lo impediría)
	end

	-- INVARIANTE: sin argumento, siempre Config.Timer.Duration (60s exactos)
	self.duration = duration or Config.Timer.Duration
	self.endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + self.duration
	self.running = true
	self.generation += 1
	local generation = self.generation
	self.machine:SetState("Running")

	TimerStartRemote:FireClient(self.player, {
		duration = self.duration,
		endsAt = self.endsAt,
		warningThreshold = self.warningThreshold,
	})

	task.spawn(function()
		local lastSync = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		while self.running and self.generation == generation do
			local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			local remaining = self.endsAt - now

			if remaining <= 0 then
				self:expire()
				break
			end

			-- Transición Running -> Warning (la FSM garantiza que ocurra una sola vez)
			if self.machine.CurrentState == "Running" and remaining <= self.warningThreshold then
				self.machine:SetState("Warning")
				if self.OnWarning then
					self.OnWarning()
				end
			end

			if self.OnTick then
				self.OnTick(remaining)
			end

			-- Re-sincronización periódica del HUD
			if now - lastSync >= Config.Timer.SyncRate then
				lastSync = now
				TimerSyncRemote:FireClient(self.player, {
					remaining = remaining,
					state = self.machine.CurrentState,
				})
			end

			task.wait(Config.Timer.TickRate)
		end
	end)
end

function TimerService:Stop(reason: string)
	if not self.running then
		return
	end
	self.running = false
	self.generation += 1 -- invalida el bucle en curso
	self.machine:SetState("Stopped")
	TimerEndRemote:FireClient(self.player, { result = "Stopped", reason = reason })
	if self.OnStopped then
		self.OnStopped(reason)
	end
	self.machine:SetState("Idle")
end

function TimerService:expire()
	if not self.running then
		return
	end
	self.running = false
	self.generation += 1
	self.machine:SetState("Expired")
	TimerEndRemote:FireClient(self.player, { result = "Expired" })
	if self.OnExpired then
		self.OnExpired()
	end
	self.machine:SetState("Idle")
end

export type Timer = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Internal, TimerService))

return TimerService

--!strict
--============================================================
-- DeliveryService (Script) — v2
-- Ubicación: ServerScriptService
-- Controlador principal. Autoridad del servidor: recompensa y
-- validaciones ocurren AQUÍ para evitar exploits.
--
-- Cambios v2: el contador lo gestiona TimerService (Mecánica 02)
-- con duración INVARIANTE de Config.Timer.Duration (60s).
-- v2.1: estación de recogida — cualquier ProximityPrompt llamado
-- "RequestDeliveryPrompt" en Workspace también solicita entregas.
--============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)
local DeliveryStateMachine = require(script.Parent.DeliveryStateMachine)
local TimerService = require(script.Parent.TimerService)

type Modifier = Config.DeliveryModifier

type Assignment = {
	destination: BasePart,
	modifier: Modifier,
	reward: number,
}

-- Remotos de entrega (se crean si no existen: el módulo es autónomo)
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryRemotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotesFolder.Name = "DeliveryRemotes"
	remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getOrCreateRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local remote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return remote
	end
	local newRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	newRemote.Name = name
	newRemote.Parent = remotesFolder
	return newRemote
end

local RequestDelivery = getOrCreateRemote("RequestDelivery")   -- Cliente -> Servidor: pedir entrega
local DeliveryComplete = getOrCreateRemote("DeliveryComplete") -- Cliente -> Servidor: aviso de llegada
local DeliveryAssigned = getOrCreateRemote("DeliveryAssigned") -- Servidor -> Cliente: datos de la entrega
local DeliveryEnded = getOrCreateRemote("DeliveryEnded")       -- Servidor -> Cliente: resultado final

local machines: { [Player]: DeliveryStateMachine.DeliveryStateMachine } = {}
local timers: { [Player]: TimerService.Timer } = {}
local assignments: { [Player]: Assignment } = {}

-- Leaderstats sencillo para acreditar la recompensa
local function ensureLeaderstats(player: Player): IntValue
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Monedas")
	if coins and coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return coins
	end
	local newCoins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	newCoins.Name = "Monedas"
	newCoins.Parent = leaderstats
	return newCoins
end

local function getRoot(player: Player): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root
	end
	return nil
end

-- 1) Selección de destino válido (dentro del rango de distancia)
local function pickDestination(origin: Vector3): (BasePart?, number?)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryPoints")
	if not folder then
		warn("[Delivery] Falta la carpeta workspace.DeliveryPoints")
		return nil, nil
	end

	local valid: { { point: BasePart, distance: number } } = {}
	for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			local distance = (child.Position - origin).Magnitude
			if distance >= Config.Delivery.MinDistance and distance <= Config.Delivery.MaxDistance then
				table.insert(valid, { point = child, distance = distance })
			end
		end
	end

	if #valid == 0 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local chosen = valid[math.random(#valid)]
	return chosen.point, chosen.distance
end

-- 2) Generación de modificador (aleatorio ponderado por Weight)
local function pickModifier(): Modifier
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, modifier in Config.Delivery.Modifiers do
		totalWeight += modifier.Weight
	end

	local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
	local cumulative = 0
	for _, modifier in Config.Delivery.Modifiers do
		cumulative += modifier.Weight
		if roll <= cumulative then
			return modifier
		end
	end
	return Config.Delivery.Modifiers[1]
end

-- 3) Cálculo de recompensa: base + distancia, ajustado por modificador
local function computeReward(distance: number, modifier: Modifier): number
	local base = Config.Delivery.BaseReward + distance * Config.Delivery.RewardPerStud
	return math.round(base * modifier.RewardMultiplier)
end

local function resetToIdle(player: Player)
	local machine = machines[player]
	if machine then
		machine:SetState("Idle")
	end
	assignments[player] = nil
end

local function failDelivery(player: Player, reason: string)
	local machine = machines[player]
	if not machine or machine.CurrentState ~= "Delivering" then
		return
	end
	local timer = timers[player]
	if timer then
		timer:Stop("Failed") -- no-op si el temporizador ya expiró
	end
	machine:SetState("Failed")
	DeliveryEnded:FireClient(player, { result = "Failed", reason = reason })
	task.defer(resetToIdle, player)
end

-- FLUJO PRINCIPAL: Asignación de entrega
local function assignDelivery(player: Player)
	local machine = machines[player]
	if not machine or machine.CurrentState ~= "Idle" then
		return -- ya tiene una entrega activa
	end

	local root = getRoot(player)
	if not root then
		return
	end

	local destination, distance = pickDestination(root.Position)
	if not destination or not distance then
		warn(("[Delivery] No hay destino válido para %s"):format(player.Name))
		return
	end

	local modifier = pickModifier()
	local reward = computeReward(distance, modifier)

	assignments[player] = {
		destination = destination,
		modifier = modifier,
		reward = reward,
	}
	machine:SetState("Delivering")

	-- 4) Notificar al cliente (incluye ArrivalRadius: nada de valores mágicos)
	DeliveryAssigned:FireClient(player, {
		destinationName = destination.Name,
		modifierId = modifier.Id,
		modifierName = modifier.DisplayName,
		difficultyTag = modifier.DifficultyTag,
		reward = reward,
		arrivalRadius = Config.Delivery.ArrivalRadius,
	})

	-- 5) Contador autoritativo en servidor: SIEMPRE exactamente 60s
	local timer = timers[player]
	if timer then
		timer:Start() -- sin argumento = Config.Timer.Duration (INVARIANTE)
	end
end

-- Completar entrega con doble validación en servidor
local function completeDelivery(player: Player)
	local machine = machines[player]
	local assignment = assignments[player]
	local timer = timers[player]
	if not machine or machine.CurrentState ~= "Delivering" or not assignment or not timer then
		return
	end

	-- Validación 1: queda tiempo (autoridad del servidor, no del cliente)
	if timer:TimeLeft() <= 0 then
		failDelivery(player, "Se agotó el tiempo")
		return
	end

	-- Validación 2: el jugador está realmente en el destino
	local root = getRoot(player)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local distance = (root.Position - assignment.destination.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > Config.Delivery.ArrivalRadius then
		return -- el cliente miente o aún no llega: ignorar
	end

	-- Éxito: detener el reloj, pagar recompensa y cerrar el ciclo
	timer:Stop("Completed")
	ensureLeaderstats(player).Value += assignment.reward
	machine:SetState("Completed")
	DeliveryEnded:FireClient(player, { result = "Completed", reward = assignment.reward })
	task.defer(resetToIdle, player)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	machines[player] = DeliveryStateMachine.new()
	ensureLeaderstats(player)

	-- Temporizador por jugador: al expirar, la entrega falla
	local timer = TimerService.new(player)
	timer.OnExpired = function()
		failDelivery(player, "Se agotó el tiempo")
	end
	timers[player] = timer
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	onPlayerAdded(player) -- por si el script carga con jugadores dentro
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	machines[player] = nil
	timers[player] = nil
	assignments[player] = nil
end)

RequestDelivery.OnServerEvent:Connect(assignDelivery)
DeliveryComplete.OnServerEvent:Connect(completeDelivery)

-- v2.1: estación de recogida — cualquier ProximityPrompt llamado
-- "RequestDeliveryPrompt" en Workspace solicita una entrega al pulsarlo.
local function wirePrompt(prompt: ProximityPrompt)
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		assignDelivery(player)
	end)
end

for _, inst in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inst.Name == "RequestDeliveryPrompt" then
		wirePrompt(inst)
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inst.Name == "RequestDeliveryPrompt" then
		wirePrompt(inst)
	end
end)

--!strict
--============================================================
-- DeliveryClient (LocalScript) — v2
-- Ubicación: StarterPlayerScripts
-- Etiqueta de información de la entrega (destino, modificador,
-- recompensa) y detección de llegada. El reloj vive en TimerHUD.
-- Solo MUESTRA información y envía solicitudes; el servidor valida.
--============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DeliveryRemotes")
local RequestDelivery = remotes:WaitForChild("RequestDelivery") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryComplete = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryComplete") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryAssigned = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryAssigned") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryEnded = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryEnded") :: RemoteEvent

-- Presentación (no son valores de mecánica)
local KEY_REQUEST = Enum.KeyCode.E -- atajo de prueba para pedir entrega
local RESULT_DISPLAY_SECONDS = 3
local ARRIVAL_CHECK_RATE = 0.25

-- UI mínima: etiqueta de información de la entrega
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DeliveryUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name = "DeliveryStatus"
label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 56)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.TextScaled = true
label.Visible = false
label.Parent = screenGui

-- Estado local de presentación
local activeDestination: BasePart? = nil
local activeArrivalRadius = 0
local deliveryActive = false
local completionRequested = false

DeliveryAssigned.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryPoints")
	local point = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(payload.destinationName)
	activeDestination = if point and point:IsA("BasePart") then point else nil
	activeArrivalRadius = payload.arrivalRadius
	deliveryActive = true
	completionRequested = false
	label.Text = string.format(
		"📦 %s | Destino: %s | Recompensa: %d",
		payload.modifierName,
		payload.destinationName,
		payload.reward
	)
	label.Visible = true

	-- Aviso de llegada (el servidor valida de verdad)
	task.spawn(function()
		while deliveryActive do
			if activeDestination and not completionRequested then
				local character = player.Character
				local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
					local distance = (root.Position - activeDestination.Position).Magnitude
					if distance <= activeArrivalRadius then
						completionRequested = true
						DeliveryComplete:FireServer()
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(ARRIVAL_CHECK_RATE)
		end
	end)
end)

DeliveryEnded.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	deliveryActive = false
	activeDestination = nil
	if payload.result == "Completed" then
		label.Text = string.format("✅ ¡Entrega completada! +%d monedas", payload.reward)
	else
		label.Text = "❌ Entrega fallida: " .. tostring(payload.reason)
	end
	task.delay(RESULT_DISPLAY_SECONDS, function()
		if not deliveryActive then
			label.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end)

-- Atajo de prueba: pulsar E para solicitar una entrega
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == KEY_REQUEST then
		RequestDelivery:FireServer()
	end
end)

--!strict
--============================================================
-- TimerHUD (LocalScript)
-- Ubicación: StarterPlayerScripts
-- Mecánica 02: el tiempo aparece en el HUD.
-- Reloj de cuenta regresiva sincronizado con el servidor mediante
-- workspace:GetServerTimeNow(). Solo MUESTRA el tiempo; el
-- servidor es la autoridad.
--============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TimerRemotes")
local TimerStart = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerStart") :: RemoteEvent
local TimerSync = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerSync") :: RemoteEvent
local TimerEnd = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerEnd") :: RemoteEvent

-- Presentación (valores visuales, no de mecánica)
local COLOR_NORMAL = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local COLOR_WARNING = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
local HUD_REFRESH = 0.1
local RESULT_HIDE_DELAY = 2
local SYNC_TOLERANCE = 0.5 -- tolerancia de deriva antes de corregir

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TimerHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local clockLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
clockLabel.Name = "Clock"
clockLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
clockLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 84) -- debajo de la etiqueta de entrega
clockLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 64)
clockLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
clockLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_NORMAL
clockLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
clockLabel.TextScaled = true
clockLabel.Visible = false
clockLabel.Parent = screenGui

-- Estado local de presentación
local endsAt = 0
local warningThreshold = 0
local hudActive = false

local function formatClock(seconds: number): string
	local total = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	local mins = math.floor(total / 60)
	local secs = total % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
end

TimerStart.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	endsAt = payload.endsAt
	warningThreshold = payload.warningThreshold
	hudActive = true
	clockLabel.Visible = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while hudActive do
			local remaining = endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if remaining <= 0 then
				clockLabel.Text = "00:00"
				break -- el servidor anunciará el resultado
			end
			clockLabel.Text = formatClock(remaining)
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = if remaining <= warningThreshold then COLOR_WARNING else COLOR_NORMAL
			task.wait(HUD_REFRESH)
		end
	end)
end)

TimerSync.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	-- Corrección de deriva: el servidor es la autoridad del tiempo
	local expectedEndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + payload.remaining
	if math.abs(expectedEndsAt - endsAt) > SYNC_TOLERANCE then
		endsAt = expectedEndsAt
	end
end)

TimerEnd.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	hudActive = false
	if payload.result == "Expired" then
		clockLabel.Text = "00:00"
		clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_WARNING
	end
	task.delay(RESULT_HIDE_DELAY, function()
		if not hudActive then
			clockLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end)
